effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

bio: The Imperial Legions' poster boy, you can't walk through the Celestial City without seeing Stade's perfect mug winking back at you. Ask kids born in the Eternal Empire what they want to be when they grow up, and they'll say they want to be just like Stade. Despite all this attention, Stade doesn't let it get to his head. All he wants to do is serve the Lightseekers. And he does so valiantly.
